TARGET: Crypto Algo Trading
STATUS: Foundation without which algo trading becomes gambling.

H2 — What Counts as an Anomaly in Crypto Trading

Point Anomalies

Isolated extreme deviations.
High risk of fake price entry or
margin-destroying slippage.

Example: Candle with 50x
average volume, or BTC/USDT
spread spiking to 0.5%.

Collective Anomalies

Normal individual events that
form a manipulative aggregate.
Note: Spoofing acts as a signal
needing corroboration.

Example: Place-cancel

spoofing loops with a 100:1
order-to-trade ratio.

Contextual Anomalies

Normal values occurring in the
wrong environmental context.

Example: London session
trading volumes occurring at
3 AM UTC on a Sunday.
